notes.title: The game of life: sauna and development
notes.content:
This fortnight Chengdu is officially in sauna mode, living in Chengdu can even save you big money on sauna costs every year. Every mid-summer, the natural 360 degree deathless giant sauna allows people to detoxify effectively every day, and occasionally a wild wind and gathering rain does not cool much, but adds water for the next round of steaming.

1. Shattering and reading
The students in the studio continued their development by relying on the air conditioning and wrapping themselves in blankets in the cold temperatures of the office. The art students continued to optimise the tedious lighting, effects and materials, the planning students adapted the music and sound effects line by line, and the programming students improved the operation of each scene and fixed the bugs little by little. The new content is not much, but it is very complicated and complicated, so I would like to thank them for their hard work in the face of the tight schedule. So, when I was supervised by the players' QQ group today, I could answer with rare confidence: "I do my best!". .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/3a8d913304c77a706f424eac4802935577bd26c6.png[/img]
It still looks like serious work is being done (the picture shows a before-and-after comparison of some of the scenes in Chapter 5)

At this stage, the task facing the studio is starting to move from the surface to the point, and the daily discussions are becoming more and more detailed, with more time being spent on the finer details and polishing parts that were easily overlooked in the past. This is, of course, a time-consuming and labour-intensive task that we all have to work on together, so that even in the face of the summer discount season, we have no distractions (or time, to be precise).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/52427b077860b0f14c7c6b95f87070a1ba2b63fc.gif[/img]
Curator and art discussing how to implement the new transitional levels

2. Is the music ready yet?
We've had a breakthrough with the music we've been waiting for, and we finally have something that's basically in place. The music is far more complex than we thought it would be, and the overall music will be based on the completed game levels, as well as the fit of the individual chapters and the integrity of the chapters, so there is not a lot of time left for the music guy, but we are happy to give him a hard time, as much as the players are happy to push us.

3. soon, soon
This has been the standard phrase we used to use when facing players' soul-torture. The development cycle of "Hidden Dreams" is quite long, and it can be called a miracle that it has survived so far. The result is now a maverick greeting group. The good thing is that even though it is such an uninteresting group of players, many of the old players have stayed in the group for two or three years and have never left, so whenever we see them coming out to support the game again, we are actually happy and grateful. So even though it's difficult, we'll have to digest it ourselves. Almost there, thank you.

notes.title: Game life: full of vitality
notes.content:
After the Dragon Boat Festival, game development has entered the final stage before launching, and the entire June will be pushed forward in a relatively tight development rhythm. We hope that "Tibetan Dream" can meet with friends during this summer vacation as scheduled, so the finishing work this month is particularly important.
The studio held a communication meeting before the festival to sort out the work schedule in June, and refined it to the weekly task arrangement. As a studio that has been lying flat for a long time, this can be regarded as a huge breakthrough. In the process of communication, I could vaguely feel that everyone's emotions were high. The efforts of the past few years are finally coming to fruition, and I can't help but look forward to it.
The most important point of the research and development work in June is to continue to optimize the overall performance of the game. Although there are still many difficulties, recently, with the cooperation of all students, the optimization problem can make a little progress or breakthrough every day. The established expectations are approaching step by step.
In addition to performance optimization, there are several things that need to be dealt with in the next month:
1. Optimization of typography puzzles
The typography puzzle is set at the foot of Maiji Mountain in Chapter 2. It is a puzzle solution that has gone through many twists and turns. It was even abandoned by the team because it could not find a satisfactory form of expression in the design level for a long time. In the early demo, it was retained due to the positive feedback from players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/88c8960c3a57bb205ab9b04ed6082c888cb0f3f7.jpg[/img]

2. The Beautification, Decoration and Merging of Partial Buildings in Chapter 5
The map in Chapter 5 climbs up the snow-capped mountains. There are a large number of building communities along the way, and the individual buildings are also relatively large, so the corresponding art work is heavy and heavy, so we put some buildings with complicated level design in the later stage when it is relatively stable. Beautify and decorate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/56e4f72ff174ec024d42800db5f31feefb607fc0.png[/img]

This time, it is mainly for decoration of a movable building. The building is divided into three floors, and each floor is equipped with different organs. The above picture shows the conceptual design of the first floor. Some areas of this building will also be linked with the previous chapters, and there are various jumps specially designed for the disabled party to help you spend more daily time, which is really exciting!

3. Music and sound effects
Many comrades in the official QQ group think that the students in the production team are very Buddha, so I don't blame them. After all, they have not had contact with our music partners, otherwise they should think that we are still quite curvy.
Fortunately, the long-awaited and long-awaited production of music and sound effects is finally coming to an end. The problem that everyone has long complained that the soundtrack and sound effects are too simple is finally expected to be changed. There are music and sound effects friends. The reason why the time cycle will be changed Pulling so long is actually because they have extremely high professional requirements for soundtracks. We believe that the final effect is worth looking forward to.

4. Other
In addition to the above-mentioned content, there are many other arrangements waiting for us to complete, such as the behind-the-scenes production list and thank you list, the lighting adjustment of some scenes, the adaptation of the little fox standby action, the replacement of the model, etc. . Thinking of this, I can't help but feel like another day full of vitality!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/02eb73adcc5b931d4d0dd0758effd7040b464c18.jpg[/img]

At the beginning of the month, I participated in the demo festival held by WeGame, and I was fortunate to receive good player reviews. This undoubtedly gave us some confidence. Thank you for your support and suggestions for "Hidden Dream". Let's make persistent efforts. I hope this summer can give us a lot of confidence. Have a nice experience everyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/a05c8a8558fc1e1a8805e85c6bb2c622df6b31d6.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog
notes.content:
In the last two weeks, the studio has burst into development, mainly dealing with the following boards.
1. Adjustment of the terrain environment in Chapter 5.
The terrain materials in Chapter 5 have been enriched so that the terrain surfaces are no longer homogeneous and raw. The environment was then decorated and beautified by laying vegetation and decorating buildings and stacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/90960049e6a038ab2ac19323a09349091536cdb4.jpg[/img]
The screenshot shows one of the many terrain adjustments in Chapter 5, which is a more time-consuming and tedious project

2. Replacement of the title animation.
In the previous updates, you may have already had some idea of the game's title animation. At this stage, in addition to the subsequent adaptation of the music and animations, this title animation with independent artist Sakai Da has been completed and we have proceeded to replace the full title animation for the latest version of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/7a361673925c605cf52ffa24867a402d2d506f63.gif[/img]
This section of the animation is a foreshadowing of the scene in Chapter 5, where the view from the foothills of the mountain is of the snowy mountains to be crossed, in Tibetan "Gesang" means "good times" or "happiness".

3. Adapting the new series of moves
As a result of the workshop on the design of the moves in Chapter 6 (see: Game of Life: Pushing My Fox), the studio has adapted the main moves for Chapter 6, so for the past two weeks we have been going through a cycle of discussing, testing, solving doubts and adapting the new moves, with the aim of solving this long-standing problem as quickly as possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/e07f18af7becbfc7e455a8b14620ba8146f0af00.gif[/img]
We also took the opportunity to optimise some of the characters' movements, with the intention of fixing some of the movement design problems that existed in the early stages with the princess and the fox. The art and programming students ate dozens of popsicles out of the studio fridge in order to make all the animations work smoothly. At the time of writing, they are walking back and forth more than 10,000 steps to each other to communicate about a new technical problem.

4. Performance optimization
Another fellow programmer in the studio, who is also our Chief Health Officer (yes, Tianfu Software Park requires every company to have this position), Dr. Huang, who eats junk food every day, has recently had a phase of improvement in his allergic rhinitis, and his sneezing has dropped a lot. This has certainly taken a lot out of him, and well, work does make you healthier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/808622d3ec202843183591eccaf12d40928bb2d4.gif[/img]
Trust me, this is not a posed shot, the studio really hasn't been slacking off lately

5. Improve the music sound effects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/798778288fff795dfcbcb9036eb33fc03f47d91c.jpg[/img]
After the five-day holiday, it's summer, so we hope you've all been able to catch the tail end of spring and find your own holiday fun.

Thank you for your interest, and if you haven't experienced our Hidden Dreams yet, you can go ahead and download the free trial to take on the challenge.

notes.title: Devlog: A Dream of Snow Mountain
notes.content:
[h1]News This Week[/h1]

We are entering the final phase of our development, and the team was pushed hard to achieve the goal of catching up the weekly-schedule. So this week, we've done a lot of discussion and testing on how to present something new in Chapter Six, and luckily, we figured it out. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/491540f253d8b1cf959f95bd9a2943c8aa4644dc.jpg[/img]

Since our players will need to spend more time and experience some difficulties in the snow-capped mountains of Chapter Five, we want to relieve you guys of this stress in this final Chapter and trying to bring something different and refreshing. It's just like how the Princess Wencheng felt like after going through all this journey to Tibet. You guys will find it out in our game soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/62cfe4e5ea5a336703a93ff68d6e0f41ba15b839.jpg[/img]

BTW, due to COVID-19 regulations in Shanghai, 2021 WEPLAY EXPO will be postponed, so it's a pity we will see you guys this time, next time maybe. Just stay tuned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/4f90744f609603f9f61fc6d4b4bb42a2501dd115.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog#7
notes.content:
We believe that many friends have already played the latest game Demo of "Hidden Dreams", but some friends do not know the situation of the previous version of the Demo, so we simply chose two point to talk：


1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/bed2ebf4886e5a270aa9a2bcf0cc69b4b00e0f73.png[/img]

The new version adds more vines here, so that players can face the vines once they come, and then ignite the vines to start the follow-up. The little helper of the Tibetan fox that we said in the past has also joined in to help Sokoban. We also designed decals on the ground, which can guide the players to try to push the box to the decal position. This way, we can better understand the intent of the level design and reduce the jump to the upper level due to the location of the box. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/24ea734c44d2bae5ced61adb3e37ea426255cbad.png[/img]


2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/a691eb05a74a19c9e2259f1b207f3cec15caadcb.png[/img]

In the past, players arrived at the top of the front mountain, and they couldn’t react quickly to the control after the viewing angle was changed.
Now that the players come to the top of the mountain, with the newly added text and icon prompts (the decals are also added on the mountain), they can quickly and directly understand that this paragraph can be controlled by the mouse. We also adjusted the angle of the lens to increase the visual impact. Later, the same mechanism as the door may also be added with a new lens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/0cbec9a84cdad1986a28e8c79d95471697e69d47.png[/img]
